claims.text: White Sands Proving Ground was established 9 July 1945; the Trinity test occurred 16 July 1945 near its northern boundary; 67 of 100 captured V-2 rockets were fired here 1946-1951 and 35 Operation Paperclip scientists were working at the proving ground by 1946.

edges.label: The green fireballs conference was convened at Los Alamos
edges.note: Edward Teller and Lincoln LaPaz were among the attendees; the laboratory's own account records that the phenomenon was ultimately dismissed as a national security threat.

edges.label: Los Alamos and White Sands bracket the 1948-1951 green fireball reporting corridor
edges.note: The 16 February 1949 conference at Los Alamos and the Project Twinkle instrumented observation effort in southern New Mexico both arose from reporting across this corridor.
